Artist: Pixies · Title: Alec Eiffel · Album: Alec Eiffel · Year: 1991 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1990's/Pixies - Alec Eiffel.mp4
"Alec Eiffel" is a song by the American alternative rock band Pixies, from their 1991 album Trompe le Monde.
The song was written and sung by frontman Black Francis, produced by Gil Norton and recorded during the album's recording sessions.
"Alec Eiffel" was released as a single in France, the United Kingdom, and the United States, and was their third single from the album.
The discography of the Pixies, an American alternative rock band, includes nine studio albums, 26 singles, seven compilations, one mini-LP, and four EPs as of September 2024.
Pixies formed in Boston, Massachusetts in 1985.
Following their 1987 demo tape, the band signed to the English independent record label 4AD.
Little Pixie Geldof (born 17 September 1990) is an English-born model and singer.
She is the third daughter of Irish musician Bob Geldof and Paula Yates.
